title: My nightmare.
content: My dream is always me stuck in this slide. It seems to never end but when i get to anxious in my dream i always end up either in an empty mall with unrecognizable faces just voices or im in a jungle gym. The issue i have is im very aware im dreaming. :( i got curious one night and asked what is this? And where am i? And i vividly remember getting yelled at so bad i woke up screaming.
